name: Cohere Compass
desc: Managed enterprise search and retrieval for agents.
desc_zh: 面向智能体的托管式企业搜索与检索
solves: RAG means running a vector database and an indexing pipeline. Compass parses documents, indexes them, and serves retrieval without either.
solves_zh: 做 RAG 意味着自己养一套向量库和索引流水线。Compass 解析文档、建索引并提供检索，两样都不用你管。
best_for: You need document retrieval for an agent and do not want to run the index yourself.
best_for_zh: 你的智能体需要文档检索，但不想自己维护索引。
